title: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. final prospectus dated June 11, 2026
excerpt: The June 2026 IPO offered 555,555,555 Class A shares at USD 135, expected about USD 74.4 billion of net proceeds, and left Elon Musk with approximately 82.4% of voting power immediately after the offering.
summary: The final SEC prospectus supplies the offering price and size, post-offering share classes, option and RSU overhang, use of proceeds, common-control transaction history, risk factors, and concentrated-control evidence.
